title: Payout to a Maltese account was accepted at onboarding and bounced days later
details:
A merchant added a payout account with the IBAN MT84 MALT 0110 0001 2345 MTLC AST0 01S
and our onboarding form accepted it. The payout ran four days later and was returned by the
correspondent bank; the merchant went unpaid for a week and is now asking for compensation.

Malta is not a corridor we are licensed to pay out to. Neither are Brazil (BR) or Türkiye (TR), and we
have found accepted accounts for both of those in the payout table as well.

The IBAN itself is genuine — it is a real, correctly-formed Maltese account number, so the checksum is
fine. The problem is that we should not have taken it in the first place. Onboarding is supposed to
refuse any country we do not process, and it is letting them through instead.

UK and German accounts are unaffected; those are validated properly, including the length check and the
transposed-digit case.
